body.raw:
{
  "encryptedPayload": "GENERATE_USING_npm_run_webhook:encrypt",
  "organizationId": "{{organization_id}}",
  "correlationId": "{{correlation_id}}"
}

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP-BY-STEP: Generate Encrypted Payload
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Open terminal and run:
   npm run webhook:encrypt -- \\
     --url http://localhost:3000/api/v1 \\
     --payload '{"organizationId":"YOUR_ORG_ID","mto":"WESTERN_UNION","country":"US","paymentChannel":"bank","currency":"USD","feeType":"fixed_fees","marginType":"fixed_margin"}'

2. Copy the base64 encryptedPayload from output

3. Paste it above in the "encryptedPayload" field

4. Replace {{organization_id}} with your actual org UUID

5. Send the request

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
QUICK REFERENCE: Encryption Methods
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The encryption is RSA-2048 OAEP with SHA-256.
You can generate encrypted payloads using:

• Node.js: npm run webhook:encrypt
• Python: from Crypto.Cipher import PKCS1_OAEP
• Go: github.com/golang-jwt/jwt
• Java: javax.crypto.Cipher

See WEBHOOK_SETUP.md for full examples in each language.

item.description:
Create corridor via encrypted webhook (RSA-2048 OAEP-SHA256). No JWT auth required.

Use the npm script to encrypt your payload:
  npm run webhook:encrypt -- --url http://localhost:3000/api/v1 --payload '{...}'

Or use the WebhookClient directly in your code.

See WEBHOOK_SETUP.md for complete documentation.
